intro.text: A powerful figure who seems to have been allied with Rayse, and against whom Hoid holds a deep grudge.
A powerful figure against whom Hoid holds a deep grudge, and whom Tanavast thought capable but shrewd.

items.text: Bavadin seems to have had some alliance with Rayse. Hoid bears a deep grudge against both of them, and the dislike appears to be mutual.

personality.text: Even before taking up her power, she was known as shrewd and capable.
